headline: SharkNinja Selected to Join S&P 500 Index After 100% Stock Rally in 2026
summary: Home appliance maker SharkNinja will be added to the benchmark S&P 500 index. The stock has gained nearly 100% in 2026, supported by positive analyst evaluations and growth expectations.
why: Inclusion in the S&P 500 obligates index-tracking mutual funds and ETFs to purchase shares of the incoming company.

impacts.name: SharkNinja, Inc.
impacts.why: SharkNinja shares were selected to join the benchmark S&P 500 index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: SharkNinja shares were boosted by the announcement of its inclusion in the S&P 500 index.
